events.name: Tebex Purchase
description: Called when a Tebex payment's commands are about to be delivered.
examples:
on tebex purchase:
	broadcast "%event-player% bought %package%!"

events.name: Tebex Command
description: Called for each command Tebex wants executed. Cancelling stops skript-tebex from running it, but the command is still marked as executed with Tebex unless you use 'mark the tebex command as unexecuted'.

events.name: Tebex Queue Check
description: Called after each successful poll of the Tebex command queue.
examples:
on tebex queue check:
	broadcast "%due players% players have purchases waiting"

events.name: Tebex Queue Error
description: Called when a Tebex API request fails.
examples:
on tebex queue error:
	send "Tebex error: %reason%" to console

events.name: Tebex Connect
description: Called when skript-tebex authenticates with Tebex and loads store information.
examples:
on tebex connect:
	broadcast "Connected to %tebex store name%"

events.name: Tebex Disconnect
description: Called when skript-tebex stops polling, for example after the secret key is cleared.
examples:
on tebex disconnect:
	send "Tebex polling stopped" to console

conditions.name: Has Pending Tebex Commands
description: Checks whether a player has commands waiting in the Tebex command queue.
patterns: %player% does(n't| not) have [any] pending tebex commands

conditions.name: Tebex Is Connected
description: Checks whether skript-tebex is authenticated with Tebex and polling the command queue.
examples:
if tebex is connected:
	broadcast "Store is online"

effects.name: Create Tebex Basket Link
description: Creates a Tebex Headless basket that contains the given packages for a player, then stores the basket's checkout link in a variable. Requires a Headless public token to be configured. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
patterns: create [a] tebex basket link for %tebexpackages% for %player% and store (it|the result) in %object%

effects.name: Create Tebex Checkout Link
description: Creates a checkout link for a single package and stores the URL in a variable. Accepts a tebex package or a package id, and a player or a username. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples:
create a tebex checkout link for {_package} for player and store it in {_url}
	send {_url} to player
patterns: create [a] tebex checkout link for %tebexpackage/number% for %player/string% and store (it|the result) in %object%

effects.name: Create Tebex Coupon
description: Creates a percentage discount coupon in your Tebex store and stores it in a variable. The given name is used as the coupon code; a random code is generated when no name is given. The coupon never expires unless an expiry timespan is given. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples:
create a tebex coupon named "SUMMER" with 25 percent discount expiring in 7 days and store it in {_coupon}
send "Use %code of {_coupon}% at checkout" to player
patterns: create [a] tebex coupon [named %string%] with %number% [percent] discount [expiring in %timespan%] and store (it|the result) in %object%

effects.name: Create Tebex Gift Card
description: Creates a gift card with the given balance and stores it in a variable. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples:
create a tebex giftcard worth 10 with note "Event prize" and store it in {_card}
send "Your code: %code of {_card}%" to player
patterns: create [a] tebex giftcard worth %number% [with note %string%] and store (it|the result) in %object%

effects.name: Delete Tebex Coupon
description: Deletes a coupon from your Tebex store. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: delete the tebex coupon {_coupon}

effects.name: Fetch Tebex Community Goals
description: Fetches the community goals of your Tebex store into a list variable. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples:
fetch the tebex community goals and store them in {_goals::*}
send "%name of {_goals::1}%" to player
patterns: fetch [the] tebex community goals and store (them|the result) in %objects%

effects.name: Fetch Tebex Player Lookup
description: Looks up a player's Tebex purchase history and stores the lookup in a variable. Accepts a player or a username. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: fetch the tebex lookup of player and store it in {_lookup}
patterns: fetch [the] tebex lookup of %player/string% and store (it|the result) in %object%

effects.name: Fetch Tebex Payments
description: Fetches the most recent payments of your Tebex store into a list variable. Fetches the last 10 payments when no amount is given. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: fetch the last 25 tebex payments and store them in {_payments::*}
patterns: fetch [the] [last %number%] tebex payments and store (them|the result) in %objects%

effects.name: Fetch Tebex Purchases
description: Fetches the packages a player has purchased into a list variable. Accepts a player or a username. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: fetch the tebex purchases of player and store them in {_purchases::*}
patterns: fetch [the] tebex purchases of %player/string% and store (it|them|the result) in %objects%

effects.name: Fetch Tebex Sales
description: Fetches the sales that are currently running in your Tebex store into a list variable. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: fetch the tebex sales and store them in {_sales::*}
patterns: fetch [the] tebex sales and store (them|the result) in %objects%

effects.name: Force Tebex Queue Check
description: Polls the Tebex command queue immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.
examples:
on command /tebexcheck:
	force a tebex queue check

effects.name: Mark Tebex Command As Unexecuted
description: Marks the command of a tebex command event as unexecuted, so Tebex delivers it again on a later queue check. Can only be used in a tebex command event.

effects.name: Open Tebex Store
description: Opens the Tebex store GUI, or a single category of it, to players.
examples:
on command /store:
	open the tebex store to player

effects.name: Refresh Tebex Listing
description: Refreshes the cached Tebex store listing of categories and packages. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: refresh the tebex listing

effects.name: Set Tebex Secret Key
description: Sets the Tebex secret key, saves it to the config and reconnects to Tebex with it. The key is saved off the main thread, so the script is not delayed.
examples: set the tebex secret key to "your-secret-key"

effects.name: Tebex Ban
description: Bans a player from your Tebex store, optionally with a reason and an IP address. Accepts a player or a username. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: tebex ban player for "chargeback"

effects.name: Void Tebex Gift Card
description: Voids a gift card so its remaining balance can no longer be used. This effect waits for the Tebex API and therefore delays the script.
examples: void the tebex giftcard {_card}

expressions.name: Tebex Category Packages
description: The packages inside a Tebex category.
examples:
loop packages of {_category}:
	send "%name of loop-value%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex Due Players
description: The players that currently have commands waiting in the Tebex command queue.
examples:
on tebex queue check:
	broadcast "%size of tebex due players% players are waiting"

expressions.name: Seconds Until Next Tebex Check
description: The number of seconds until the next poll of the Tebex command queue. Returns 0 when the queue is not running.
examples: send "Next check in %seconds until the next tebex check% seconds" to player

expressions.name: Pending Tebex Commands
description: The commands that Tebex has queued for a player.
examples:
loop the pending tebex commands of player:
	send "%loop-value%" to console

expressions.name: Tebex Store Information
description: The name, id, domain or currency of your Tebex store. Empty until skript-tebex has connected to Tebex.
examples:
on tebex connect:
	broadcast "Connected to %tebex store name% (%tebex store currency%)"

expressions.name: Tebex Categories
description: All categories in the cached Tebex store listing.
examples:
loop tebex categories:
	send "%name of loop-value%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex Code
description: The code of a Tebex coupon or gift card.
examples: send "%code of {_coupon}%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex Description
description: The description of a Tebex package, category or community goal.
examples: send "%description of {_package}%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex ID
description: The id of a Tebex package, category, coupon, gift card, ban or community goal.
examples: send "%id of {_package}%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex Name
description: The name of a Tebex package, category, player, sale or community goal.
examples: send "%name of {_package}%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex Packages
description: All packages in the cached Tebex store listing.
examples:
loop tebex packages:
	send "%name of loop-value%: %price of loop-value%" to player

expressions.name: Tebex Price
description: The total price of a Tebex package, including any discount applied by a sale.
examples: send "%price of {_package}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Package
description: A package from your Tebex store listing.
examples: send "%name of {_package}%: %price of {_package}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Command
description: A command queued by Tebex for delivery to a player.
examples:
on tebex command:
	broadcast the tebex command

types.name: Tebex Category
description: A category of packages from your Tebex store listing.
examples: send "%name of {_category}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Player
description: A player with commands queued for delivery.
examples:
on tebex purchase:
	broadcast "%name of event-tebex player%"

types.name: Tebex Payment
description: A payment made in your Tebex store.
examples: fetch the last 5 tebex payments and store them in {_payments::*}

types.name: Tebex Player Lookup
description: The result of looking up a player's Tebex purchase history.
examples: fetch the tebex lookup of player and store it in {_lookup}

types.name: Tebex Ban
description: A ban recorded in your Tebex store.
examples: tebex ban player for "chargeback"

types.name: Tebex Coupon
description: A coupon from your Tebex store.
examples: send "%code of {_coupon}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Gift Card
description: A gift card from your Tebex store.
examples: send "%code of {_giftcard}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Sale
description: A sale running in your Tebex store.
examples: send "%name of {_sale}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Community Goal
description: A community goal from your Tebex store.
examples: send "%name of {_goal}%" to player

types.name: Tebex Store
description: Information about your Tebex store.
examples: send "%tebex store name%" to player
